findings.text: follow-on: the declared write paths name an evidence fragment and a figure directory that the diff does not produce, so the node lands no durable landing artifact of its own.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 89eb214e4506484260151117df551f1e4a7a6199; seven files, each replacing a local revision-to-commit peel with a call to recovery._resolve_commit.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when names a walk test, an agreement test and a zero-added-failure population; the manifest records all three, and the two population logs and negative_control.log are on disk under the run directory.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to route every commit-citation resolution through one hardened function; the diff removes the local revision peel in reckon/crew/reports.py:1525, reckon/crew/promotion.py:441, reckon/crew/recovery.py:1499 and reckon/crew/routing.py:2435 and calls reckon/crew/recovery.py:380 _resolve_commit, which carries --verify, --end-of-options and timeout=10.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, commit 513d1cc, the baseline_population.log and head_population.log, the head_ledger.log run and the negative control.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The prompt fenced reports.py, promotion.py, recovery.py, routing.py and the test file; the resume advice granted reckon/crew/dispatch.py and reckon/interface_counts.py; every path in the diff is inside that extended set.

justifications.durability: negative_control.log shows tests/test_one_function_resolves_a_citation.py::test_only_the_shared_resolver_peels_a_revision_to_a_commit failing with EXIT=1 when promotion's local peel is restored.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_one_function_resolves_a_citation.py carries both the walk and the agreement tests, and the manifest records their runs plus a population delta of zero added failures across the same four ids.
justifications.fit: the change extends the existing owner reckon/crew/recovery.py:380 rather than adding a second one, though the import is module-level in promotion.py:51 and function-local in reports.py, routing.py and interface_counts.py.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery.py:380 _resolve_commit is the only ^{commit} peel left in reckon/ and every former site imports it.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path (reckon/crew/reports.py, promotion.py, recovery.py, routing.py, dispatch.py, interface_counts.py, tests/test_one_function_resolves_a_citation.py) is inside the granted scope, with nothing the goal does not imply.
